By way of the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of the Criminal Procedure, 1973, the petitioner seeks setting aside the impugned order dated 03.11.2023 passed by learned Trial Court,
Delhi in Bail Application No.1770/2023 in FIR No. 248/2022 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S. Vasant Kunj, Delhi.

2. After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission to withdraw the present application as the regular bail to the applicant has already been granted by the learned Sessions Court on 09.11.2023.
